name: mist run game plays the platformer by default
body:
Dean (2026-11-16): `mist run game` showed only a block and a gem. Cause: with no game directory `lantern` runs the engine's stub scene (log lines tagged `[stub]`); only `mist run game ../games/platformer` plays the game.

Fix: `lantern` with no argument runs `../games/platformer`, and `lantern --stub` runs the stub scene. check-window.sh passes `--stub`. README, docs/running.md and the engine docs say so.
